feedback.problem: Suppose $A$ is a $8\times 7$ matrix and $B$ is a  $2\times 8$ matrix. What are the dimensions of $BA?$
feedback.worked_solution:
There are $8$ columns in $B$ and $8$ rows in $A.$ Since the number of columns in $B$ equals the number of rows in $A,$ the matrices $B$ and $A$ are conformable for multiplication, and $BA$ is a $2\times 7$ matrix: 

$$
{B}_{2\times \boxed{\text{8}}}{\times }_{✓}{A}_{\boxed{\text{8}}\times 7}={BA}_{2\times 7}
$$
